## 1. Project Overview

**stellaris-auth** — transparent HTTPS forward proxy that injects Terraform/OpenTofu registry Bearer tokens into child processes without modifying toolchain config.

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Module | `github.com/hyvmind-io/stellaris-auth-golang` |
| Language | Go 1.26 |
| Binary | `stellaris-auth` |
| Entry point | `./cmd/stellaris-auth` |
| License | GPL-3.0-or-later |
| Distribution | GitHub Releases (GoReleaser) + composite GitHub Action (`action.yml`) |

**Flow:** credentials parsed → local MITM proxy started on `127.0.0.1:<port>` → child process (tofu/terraform/terragrunt) launched with `HTTPS_PROXY`, `HTTP_PROXY`, `SSL_CERT_FILE`, `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` injected → proxy intercepts CONNECT, terminates TLS for known hosts (MITM), injects `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, tunnels everything else → proxy gracefully shut down after child exits.

## 2. Architecture & Package Layout

```
stellaris-auth-golang/
├── cmd/stellaris-auth/
│   └── main.go              # CLI (cobra): root cmd, setup cmd, version cmd, env-var fallbacks
├── internal/
│   ├── ca/
│   │   ├── manager.go       # CA lifecycle: GenerateCA, LoadCA, EnsureCA (RSA 4096, 1-yr validity)
│   │   ├── certs.go         # Per-host leaf cert issuance + Cache (sync.Map)
│   ├── credentials/
│   │   ├── parser.go        # Parse() merges 4 sources in priority order
│   │   ├── types.go         # CredentialStore (map[hostname]token, Lookup, Set, Len, Hostnames)
│   ├── proxy/
│   │   ├── server.go        # Server: ListenAndServe, Addr, Shutdown, ServeHTTP dispatch
│   │   ├── mitm.go          # mitmHandler: hijack → TLS server → dial upstream → inject Bearer
│   │   └── tunnel.go        # tunnelHandler: raw TCP passthrough (io.Copy bidirectional)
│   └── runner/
│       ├── process.go       # Runner: Start, Wait, Run, buildChildEnv
│       ├── resolve.go       # resolveBinary: PATH lookup + interactive-shell alias expansion
│       ├── signals_unix.go  # setupSignalForwarding (SIGINT, SIGTERM, SIGQUIT)
│       └── signals_windows.go # setupSignalForwarding (os.Interrupt only)
├── action.yml               # Composite GitHub Action (install binary + wrap tool)
├── Makefile                 # All dev commands
├── .golangci.yml            # Lint config
└── .goreleaser.yml          # Multi-platform release config
```

| Layer | Owns | Does NOT own |
|-------|------|--------------|
| `cmd` | CLI flags, env-var fallbacks, startup/shutdown orchestration | Business logic |
| `internal/ca` | CA cert generation, disk persistence, leaf cert cache | Network I/O |
| `internal/credentials` | Token store, HCL parsing, env-var decoding | Network I/O |
| `internal/proxy` | CONNECT dispatch, MITM TLS, raw tunnel | Process management |
| `internal/runner` | Child process lifecycle, env injection, signal forwarding | Proxy logic |

| `make vet` | `go vet ./...` |

| `make clean` | Remove binary, `coverage.out`, test cache |
| `make install` | Install to `~/.local/bin` (override with `INSTALL_DIR=...`) |
| `make cross-build` | Verify compilation for darwin/amd64, darwin/arm64, linux/amd64, linux/arm64, windows/amd64, windows/arm64 |
| `make snapshot` | Local GoReleaser build without a tag |
| `make release` | Tagged release via GoReleaser (`goreleaser release --clean`) |
| `make deps` | Print module dependency graph |
| `make help` | List all targets |

**Run locally:**
```sh
make build
./stellaris-auth setup
./stellaris-auth tofu init
./stellaris-auth --verbose terraform plan -out=tfplan
```

## 5. Conventions & Patterns

- **Cobra CLI:** root command uses `SetInterspersed(false)` — all flags after the binary name forward verbatim to the child. Stellaris-auth flags must precede the binary name.
- **Env-var fallbacks:** `STELLARIS_AUTH_PORT`, `STELLARIS_AUTH_VERBOSE`, `STELLARIS_AUTH_INSECURE`, `STELLARIS_AUTH_CA_DIR` override flags via `PersistentPreRunE` (`resolveEnvVarFlags`).
- **Credential priority (highest → lowest):** `--registry-host host=token` > `TF_TOKEN_*`/`TOFU_TOKEN_*` env vars > `~/.tofurc` > `~/.terraformrc`.
- **Hostname encoding:** `TF_TOKEN_registry_example_com` → `__` = `-`, `_` = `.`; applied in that order to avoid collision.
- **Proxy dispatch:** only `CONNECT` method accepted; MITM if credential found for host (exact `host:port` tried first, then bare hostname); raw TCP tunnel otherwise.
- **CA storage:** `~/.stellaris-auth/ca/stellaris-auth-ca.crt` (0644) + `stellaris-auth-ca.key` (0600); RSA 4096-bit, 1-year validity; reused across invocations.
- **Leaf cert cache:** `ca.Cache` (sync.Map) — scoped per process lifetime, not persisted.
- **Child env injection:** `buildChildEnv` strips then re-sets `HTTPS_PROXY`, `HTTP_PROXY`, `SSL_CERT_FILE`, `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` (→ `ca.WriteBundle` output: proxy CA + parent `SSL_CERT_FILE` or system roots), and merges bypass patterns into `NO_PROXY`/`no_proxy`; case-insensitive key matching.
- **Bypass:** `--bypass-host` / `STELLARIS_AUTH_BYPASS_HOSTS` (`proxy.Bypass`, NO_PROXY semantics) forces tunnel even when a credential exists; checked before credential lookup in `ServeHTTP`.
- **Structured logging:** `log/slog` throughout; text handler on stderr; debug level via `--verbose`/`STELLARIS_AUTH_VERBOSE`.
- **Import grouping:** stdlib → third-party → `github.com/hyvmind-io/stellaris-auth-golang/...` (enforced by `goimports` with `local-prefixes`).
- **Error strings:** lowercase, no trailing punctuation (enforced by `revive` `error-strings` rule).
- **Test files:** `gosec` and `errcheck` suppressed in `_test.go` files (`.golangci.yml`).
- **`gosec` G304 excluded globally** — file-path reads are intentional (user-supplied config paths).

## 6. Gotchas & Notes

| Symptom / Situation | Detail |
|---------------------|--------|
| `no registry credentials found` at startup | No `--registry-host`, no `TF_TOKEN_*`/`TOFU_TOKEN_*`, no `~/.tofurc`, no `~/.terraformrc` — at least 1 source required |
| `HTTPS_PROXY is already set` warning | Parent shell has `HTTPS_PROXY` set; stellaris-auth overrides it for the child but logs a warning |
| CA key perms warning on load | Key file mode is not `0600`; `LoadCA` warns via slog but continues |
| macOS amd64 not published | GitHub Action and GoReleaser do not publish `darwin/amd64`; use `macos-14+` (arm64) runner |
| `--insecure` flag | Disables upstream TLS verification (`InsecureSkipVerify: true`); dev/self-signed certs only |
| Alias resolution (`tg`, `tf`, etc.) | `resolveBinary` spawns an interactive login shell to expand aliases; slow on first call |
| Proxy start timeout | `waitForProxy` polls `srv.Addr()` for up to 5 s; fails if listener does not bind |
| Version stamped via ldflags | `main.version` defaults to `"dev"`; set by `make build` via `git describe` or GoReleaser |
| `golangci-lint` CI installs from source | Pre-built binaries from older Go reject newer `go.mod` directive; CI runs `go install golangci-lint@v1.64.8` |
| `go 1.26` in `go.mod` | Toolchain directive — requires Go 1.26+ locally and in CI |
